steps.en: Install the bundle from the skills registry
steps.zh: 从 skills 注册表装上这个包

steps.en: Ships six self-contained skills under one Claude Code plugin marketplace
steps.zh: 用一个插件市场清单装下六个自包含 skill

steps.en: Invoke one when it fits, or let its description fire
steps.zh: 需要时手动调起，或让描述自动匹配

steps.en: Supplies the judgment for that narrow job — a method, not a runtime
steps.zh: 只提供那个窄活的判断力：给方法，不给运行时

steps.en: For a repeatable job, run the loop designer and answer its interview
steps.zh: 要把某件事做成循环，就跑循环设计 skill 并答问

steps.en: Builds sensor, controller and actuator as locally runnable pieces
steps.zh: 按模板把传感、控制、执行三段建成本地可跑的件

steps.en: Run each piece by hand, then let the workflow run on a schedule
steps.zh: 先手工逐段跑通，再挂上定时 workflow

steps.en: Opens one bounded PR per run with its memory file injected
steps.zh: 每次最多开一个 PR，并注入记忆文件

steps.en: Comment to steer it — the loop updates the PR and keeps durable feedback
steps.zh: 用评论调参：循环改 PR，并把长期反馈留下

value.en: A vendor-maintained set of agent behaviours, plus a bounded loop you can schedule and steer by comment
value.zh: 厂商维护的一组 agent 行为，外加一个可定时、可用评论调参的有界循环

sources: https://github.com/humanlayer/skills README — the six listed skills, the `npx skills add humanlayer/skills --skill <name>` install line, and the per-skill `/…` invocation lines
.claude-plugin/marketplace.json — the six plugin entries with versions, sources and categories
plugins/design-control-loop/skills/design-control-loop/SKILL.md — sensor/controller/actuator phases, the run-each-piece-locally rule, the memory file and the /iterate channel
plugins/build-iterated-agentic-loop/skills/build-iterated-agentic-loop/references/workflow-template.yml — schedule + workflow_dispatch triggers, the one-open-PR bound, memory interpolation
